The new claim pinpoints the first odd-primary torsion within the unrestricted finite triangle-free parameter age, unique eight-vertex cube geometry, and exact 256-square logical Smith/inertia profile; the inspected broader sources do not entail that finite extremal classification. residual_risks: Unindexed earlier small-graph classifications may implicitly contain the unique cube extremizer for independence-polynomial evaluation at -1.
